final: WITH regional_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 as region, COUNT(c.client_id) as count FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), total AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_count FROM regional_counts), regional_shares AS (SELECT rc.region, rc.count, CAST(rc.count AS REAL) / t.total_count as share FROM regional_counts rc CROSS JOIN total t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM regional_shares), above_average AS (SELECT rs.region, rs.count, rs.share, rs.share - a.avg_share as share_diff FROM regional_shares rs CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE rs.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(count) as total_client_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share_diff) as avg_share_diff FROM above_average
